title: Long chats and recovery · Phase 2.5
description: Paged long conversations, bounded reply context, interruption restoration and automatic independent sync retries.
notes: Long chats load the newest60 messages, with Load earlier messages for older pages and a Latest control. Earlier history stays on your account, while each reply uses a bounded recent context. Load all earlier pages before editing/regenerating an earlier transcript.
Pending turns and authoritative message ordering survive page loads and restarts. Interrupted replies restore as Stopped, and backgrounding checkpoints the current reply.

A failed chat no longer blocks independent pending changes. Sync retries with bounded backoff and resumes when the network returns or Lumen becomes active. Original-bearing writes are bounded to one message per transaction.
